item.title: Money Matters: Unveiling Financial Management Drivers among Surabaya’s University Students
item.description: The development of digital financial services and lifestyle changes among students have increased the need for sound financial management to avoid future financial problems. This study aims to analyze the effects of financial literacy, lifestyle, financial attitude, socioeconomic status, locus of control, and financial planning on financial management behavior among university students in Surabaya City. This research employed a quantitative approach using a survey method with purposive sampling.
